steps.observation: You have 60 seconds. Name three causes of World War I.

steps.action:
1. Militarism and the escalating arms race among the European powers  
2. Entangling alliances (Triple Alliance vs. Triple Entente) that turned local conflicts into a continental war  
3. Intense nationalism—including the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in Sarajevo—which ignited existing rivalries
